summary: OpenAI's president states the company completed its review of the Hugging Face incident and used the findings to upgrade its safety, security, and alignment standards across training and evaluation infrastructure, not just at deployment.

practices.reason: The post references improved internal safety/security/alignment standards for training and evaluation infrastructure but gives no specifics an outside team could adopt.
practices.quote: we've used what we've learned to drive significant upleveling in our standards for safety, security, and alignment in our training and evaluation infrastructure — not just upon deployment.
